summary: Ohmyhome Ltd filed a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026 disclosing a standby equity purchase agreement with an institutional investor for up to $40 million of Class A ordinary shares. The 24-month facility allows the company to sell shares at 50% of a reference price, with a $0.10 floor and a 9.99% beneficial ownership cap. The investor prepays $5 million and receives 200,000 shares. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation, and warrants no event-driven action beyond monitoring dilution.
